module: Flowgraph node "Position in Zone" (category repeat_instant). Tests in 2D (zone:containsPoint2D) whether a position is inside a Sites zone. Outputs: inside, outside, and enter/exit pulses when the state changes between two frames.
notes: Prints dump("No zone data!") every frame if the zone or the position is missing.
enter and exit are only written from the 2nd frame onward (self._lastInside not nil).

_executionStarted.desc: Called when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the node's internal state.

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

work.desc: Computes inside/outside and detects entering or leaving by comparing with the previous frame's state.
